Sotto, a free graded reader
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
  
  
    
      
        Sotto
        
          Sign in
          Add app
        

      

    

    
      
        
          
            A free graded reader

            Read a page. Then talk about it.

            
              A short book rewritten to your level. Tap any word, hear it read, then say what you
              think out loud to a tutor that read the same page.
            

            
              Try the tutor free for 3 days
              Read free, no account
            

            
              Reading, listening, and tap-to-translate are free for good. The voice tutor is $9.99 a
              month or $79 a year after the trial.
            

          


          
            
              
                
                  01 Read
                

                
                  02 Tap
                

                
                  03 Listen
                

                
                  04 Speak
                

                
                  05 Power
                

              

              
                
                  Chapitre un · Français · A2
                  
                    Sotto est
                    un livre
                    gratuit et
                    adapté. Vous
                    choisissez une
                    langue et
                    un niveau,
                    puis vous
                    lisez. Touchez
                    un mot pour
                    le traduire.
                  

                

                
                  
                    Your book
                    
                      Sotto
                      Pick a language and a level. The book is rewritten to fit. Books are
                        machine-adapted drafts and their levels are estimates.
                    

                  

                  
                    Tapped word
                    
                      adapté

                      graded: rewritten at your level

                      Save for later
                    

                  

                  
                    Narration
                    
                    
                      
                        
                          
                        
                        
                          
                        
                      
                      
                      0:03 · 0:08
                    

                  

                  
                    Talk about it
                    
                      
                        Tutor
                        Pourquoi le livre est-il « adapté » ?

                      

                      
                        You
                        Parce qu'il est réécrit pour mon niveau.

                      

                      
                        
                        Listening
                      

                    

                  

                  
                    
                      The tutor
                      Sotto's tutor. $9.99 a month.
                      Your own key.
                      On this device.
                      On your own machine.
                    
                  

                

              


              
                
                  Reading, listening, tap-to-translate, and saved words are free.
                

                
                  Sotto's tutor. Nothing to install, nothing to set up. Talk about the page
                  the moment you finish it. $9.99 a month or $79 a year, free for the first 3 days.
                  Start the trial. No transcripts or recordings are kept, only minutes used.
                

                
                  Your own key. Paste an OpenAI key in Settings and the page calls OpenAI
                  directly from your browser. The key stays on this device and OpenAI bills you.
                  How it works
                

                
                  On this device. Free. The tutor runs on models downloaded into your
                  browser, so nothing leaves the device. Needs a recent laptop and a large first
                  download; slower and less accurate than the plan.
                

                
                  On your own machine. Free, on your own hardware.
                  docker compose up
                  serves the app and the tutor from one origin, with local models or your own key.
                  Self-hosting guide
                

              

            

          


          
            02 · Tap

            Tap any word for its meaning.

            Save it and the mark stays on the page.

          

          
            03 · Listen

            Hear the story read aloud.

            Each word fills in as it is spoken.

          

          
            04 · Speak

            
              Talk about the passage with a voice tutor that already knows what you read.
            

            Say what you think out loud.

          

          
            05 · Power

            The tutor is the part you pay for. The rest stays free.

            Pick where it runs: Sotto's server, your own key, or this device.

          

        

      

      
        
          See it working

          
          
            
              
              
            
            A first visit in one minute: read, tap, listen, speak.
          
          
            
              
                
                Tap any word for its meaning, mid-story.
              
            

            
              
                
                Every book on the shelf is rewritten to a level.
              
            

          

        

      

      
        
          Install Sotto

          
            
              
            

            
              
                Open readsotto.app in Chrome or Safari.

                
                  Look for an install option in the browser's menu or address bar ("Install app" or
                  "Add to Home Screen").
                

                Open Sotto from where it installed.

              
              
                
                  Open readsotto.app in Safari. Tap More, then Share (or tap Share directly if it is
                  visible).
                

                
                  Scroll to "Add to Home Screen." Turn on "Open as Web App" if it appears, then tap
                  "Add."
                

                Open Sotto from your Home Screen.

              
              
                In Chrome, open the menu (⋮).

                Tap "Install app."

                Open Sotto from your home screen or app drawer.

              
              
                
                  In Chrome, click the install icon in the address bar (or the menu, then "Install
                  Sotto").
                

                Confirm "Install."

                Sotto opens as its own window.

              
              A book you have opened keeps working offline.

            

          

        

      
    

    
      
        
        
          Code Apache-2.0. Stories CC BY-SA 4.0. The books are machine-adapted drafts and their
          levels are estimates. No analytics on this page or in the app.
